context_requirements: Expression of at least one PPAR subtype (PPARA, PPARD, or PPARG)
Presence of RXR heterodimer partner and functional PPRE-driven transcription
For PPARG-mediated effects, sufficient PPARG expression or ligand-dependent activation
For PPARA-mediated effects, high fatty acid oxidation capacity (e.g., hepatocyte-like cells)
For PPARD-mediated effects, active fatty acid metabolism and/or Wnt signaling context
falsifiers: No significant change in any of the proximal_up or proximal_down genes at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
Strong and consistent upregulation of inflammatory genes (e.g., IL1B, CXCL2, PTGS2) across lines, opposite to expected anti-inflammatory PPAR effects
No difference in response between PPAR-expressing and PPAR-negative lines
Predominant upregulation of cell-cycle genes rather than the expected growth arrest and proliferation_down signature
